lines.zh: 我穿过蕨丛，绿叶扫过背。
lines.en: I push through the ferns, leaves brushing my back.

lines.zh: 我踩在湿土上，脚印很深。
lines.en: My prints sink deep into the wet soil.
A vine snags me; I shake it off.
I follow the forest stream.
My scales are dark green.

lines.zh: 我压低身子从枝下过去。
lines.en: I duck under a branch.

lines.zh: 雨滴从叶尖落到我身上。
lines.en: Rain drips onto me from the leaves.

lines.zh: 我走一步，林子里就静一下。
lines.en: Each step of mine quiets the wood.
I turn toward the sound.
I crush a vine in my path.
I pick my footing among the roots.
I move slowly through the wood.
My tail strikes a trunk.
I stop again and listen.

lines.zh: 苔色盖住鳞片，我像一段枯木。
lines.en: Moss hides my scales; I look like a dead log.
The damp clings to my scales.
I raise my head and smell rain.
There are many insects in this wood.

lines.zh: 绿色核心的光，一闪一闪。
lines.en: My green core pulses.

lines.zh: 我在等林子里安静下来。
lines.en: I wait for the wood to go quiet.

lines.zh: 苔藓爬满我的背，鸟也认错了。
lines.en: Moss covers my back and the birds mistake it for a branch.

lines.zh: 我把呼吸放轻，让它睡下去。
lines.en: I breathe softer so it can go on sleeping.
Water drips from the leaves above me.

lines.zh: 我身上的苔又长了一点。
lines.en: More moss has grown on me.
I curl my tail to my side.
The green here is very thick.
I close my eyes slowly.
I hear chopping far off.
A green core burns in my chest.
I raise my head out of the ferns.
You smell of trees.
Don't cut that tree; I keep it.
I'm twice your height.

lines.zh: 你的脚步，我隔着林子都听见。
lines.en: I hear your steps through the woods.
A stream runs between us.
Your fire frightened the wood.
Where are you going?
I don't like the sound of iron tools.

lines.zh: 我劝你站在蕨丛外，别踩进来。
lines.en: Stay outside the ferns; don't step in.

lines.zh: 绿鳞亮起来时，林子都反光。
lines.en: When my green scales flare, the grove shines.

lines.zh: 这片林子是我看着长起来的。
lines.en: I've watched this wood grow.
Your shadow falls across the ferns.
I've raised my head again.
We needn't fight.
A green scale splits; I shrink behind the tree.
My scales have frayed.
I give a low growl.
I flatten down and hold.
I shake my body.
I step back into the ferns.
My scales grow back.
I dig my claws into the soil.
I stay where I am.
I'll remember this stretch of wood.
This meat is raw.
I lower my head and take it.
This mouthful lasts me two chews.
You're holding the meat too high.
I hold it and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 放地上吧，我喷一口烤熟。
lines.en: Set it down. I'll cook it with one breath.
The meat is passable.

lines.zh: 我这点肉只够塞牙缝，还有吗。
lines.en: This barely fills the gap in my teeth. Is there more?
I'm done; is there more?
Stand over by the tree.
Stand back; don't lean in.
I smell sap.
You hit my foreleg.
I hardly shifted.
You were knocked aside.
Between us the wet soil is churned up.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，藤蔓却勾住了你。
lines.en: I step aside, but a vine snags you.
Green Coredramon's tail swept you.
I held my step back. Did I tread on you?
The trees here are too close together.

lines.zh: 蕨丛太密，我们挤成一团。
lines.en: The ferns are too thick; we crowd into each other.
Go ahead; I'll follow.
There's another in this wood.
Its scales are brighter.
We circle the same tree.
Neither of us lowered our head.
The stream runs past our feet.
We stayed a whole afternoon.
Then it went deeper in.
I stayed here.
This wood is big enough to hide us both.

lines.zh: 这林子里还有一只，鳞比我的亮。
lines.en: There is another in this wood, scales brighter than mine.
I pick up that log.
I snap it in two.

lines.zh: 我拖着它，压平了一路蕨叶。
lines.en: I drag it, flattening ferns the whole way.

lines.zh: 我用爪子压住，藤蔓缠上来。
lines.en: I pin it under my claw as vines curl over it.
It rolled into the stream.
I fished it back out.

lines.zh: 我这根烂木，连虫都不肯吃。
lines.en: Even the forest's creatures won't eat this rotten wood.
I set it beside you.
I leave half for the wood.
Take this half.

lines.zh: 蕨叶一抖，我闻到了生肉。
lines.en: The ferns twitch; I smell raw meat.
I look toward those bushes.
I've fixed that position.
I press down to the wet earth.
A dead branch just snapped.
I'm going for it.
My scales rise.
It has scales like mine.
This one can't be avoided.
I sink down into the ferns.
My throat is heating.

lines.zh: 我锁定它时，它正撞断小树。
lines.en: It snaps two saplings and charges.
I circle to the far side of the tree.

lines.zh: 我踩过湿苔，几乎没有声音。
lines.en: I step over the wet moss almost silently.
It can't see me.

lines.zh: 我贴着湿土，绕到它背后。
lines.en: I hug the wet soil and circle behind it.
I draw my tail in.
It looks up into the trees for me.

lines.zh: 我拨开蕨叶，慢慢探出半个身。
lines.en: I part the ferns and ease half my body out.
It's backed to the stream.
I shift one step nearer.
Its back is open.

lines.zh: 我把绿鳞贴进蕨叶底下。
lines.en: I press my green scales under the fern leaves.
This goes into its flank.

lines.zh: 我咬住后腿，把它拖进蕨丛。
lines.en: I bite its hind leg and drag it into the ferns.
I press down with my claws.
Fire comes up from my throat.
It's driven into the tree.
The trunk it hit snaps.
I got a mouthful of bark.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把它扔进溪水里。
lines.en: I whip my head and throw it into the stream.
It's gripping my scales.
After one bite I pull back into the tree shadow.
Its blood drips onto the ferns.
I keep my weight on it.
I pin it to the wet earth.
I rise out of the deep ferns.
Vines hang from me.

lines.zh: 我到这片林子，先嗅了嗅湿土。
lines.en: I sniff this wet soil first.
Listen all around first, then decide.
My scales have taken in the rain.
I walk to the forest clearing.
The canopy sways and I look up first.
I shake the leaves off my back.
I begin patrolling the wood.

lines.zh: 我低吼，林里的鸟全飞起来。
lines.en: I growl low and every bird in the wood takes flight.
The stream runs alongside.
I walk slowly into the shade.
I shake the rain off my scales.
I put my head out of the shade.
Fire meets my wet scales and white steam rises.

lines.zh: 我从树上摔下，砸在树根上。
lines.en: I fall and crash onto the roots.

lines.zh: 溪水把我淹住，我抬不起头。
lines.en: The stream closes over me and I can't lift my head.

lines.zh: 爆炸把周围的树都掀倒了。
lines.en: The blast knocks the trees down around me.

lines.zh: 箭插进我的脖子，卡在鳞里。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my neck, caught in the scales.

lines.zh: 那股光让我的四肢发僵。
lines.en: That light stiffens my limbs.
So hungry I'd gnaw bark.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我整只一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree and my whole body jolts.
The wood is gone and I keep falling.
